protocol_deviations.description: Null control computed by sampling K=10000 random points from F and applying [k^{-1}] via Sage scalar mult, rather than full enumeration. Full enumeration would require iterating all O(p) points for the preimage, which is O(B_frac*N * log N) point multiplications and exceeds the per-run budget for bits>=24.
protocol_deviations.impact: Null ratio is an estimate with standard error O(1/sqrt(K)) ≈ 0.01. Sufficient to confirm null ≈ 2-B_frac within ±0.02; the primary augmentation ratio is computed exactly.

protocol_deviations.description: Cell bits=28/B_frac=0.3 produced 10/10 resource_exhaustion outcomes. The augmentation computation for threshold=0.3*p≈80M iterations with Legendre symbols exceeds the 300s per-run cap in Python. The ell-isogeny x-rational-map has degree ell≤23, so polynomial evaluation adds significant cost.
protocol_deviations.impact: No augmentation data for the bits=28/B_frac=0.3 cell. Given the strong signal from the other 8 cells (aug≈null≈2-B_frac), this omission does not change the conclusion.

protocol_deviations.description: Cells 1-8 results were collected in the main run (which was interrupted by a 2-hour bash timeout before output files were written). Cell 9 was re-run in a recovery script. The results from cells 1-8 were reconstructed from captured stdout and hardcoded in the recovery script. All numerical values match the captured output exactly.

implementation_note: Augmentation ratio computed using the identity |F∪phi^{-1}(F')| = |F|+|F'|-|F∩phi^{-1}(F')| (valid because phi is bijective on E(F_p) when gcd(ell,N)=1 and N is prime). This reduces the dominant loop from O(p) to O(B_frac*p) iterations. The x-rational-map r of phi is extracted as a rational function of degree ell and evaluated with Horner's method over Z/p.
